task: WE-1 POS Cashier Loyalty CTA — main page placement architectural review

findings.summary: Main-page CTA wire-up is feasible via the existing `order:confirmed` event already emitted by PaymentComponent. Modal is permission-gated server-side. Two architecturally clean placement options exist; recommend Option B (sibling to floorplan link, gated by !dineInEnabled) to preserve V2 dine-in upgrade path.

frozen_zone.evidence: PosComponent.vue + PaymentComponent.vue + PosLoyaltyRedeemModal.vue are NOT in CLAUDE.md §7 frozen list. Only `public/js/pos-wizard.js`, `public/css/pos-wizard.css`, `resources/views/admin-pos-v4.blade.php` are frozen (POS Vanilla JS wizard). FloorplanComponent.vue itself is on a separate route (`/admin/pos/floorplan`) and is NOT touched by this task.

nf525.evidence: PosRedemptionService rejects PAID/terminal orders (PosRedemptionService.php:228-252). No fiscal sequence allocation in redemption path. composition_snapshot untouched. Backend remains source of truth for discount math (rate-based integer division of points).

branch_isolation.evidence: All loyalty endpoints scoped via existing PosLoyaltyController + BranchScope on Order model. UI doesn't bypass scope.

permission_gate.evidence: Backend `pos.redeem-loyalty` permission enforced on `POST /api/admin/pos-order/{orderId}/redeem-loyalty` via FormRequest. UI hiding CTA is a UX optimization, not a security boundary.

data_flow.current_order_source: PaymentComponent emits `order:confirmed` with `this.order` payload (PaymentComponent.vue:994). PosComponent currently handles via `triggerSuccessFlash` (PosComponent.vue:906, 1920-1927). We extend that handler to also store `currentLoyaltyOrderId` + `currentLoyaltyOrderState`.
data_flow.order_payload_shape: OrderDetailsResource → `{ id, payment_status, status, order_items, ... }` (set in PaymentComponent.vue:895-901).

reset_semantics.trigger: PaymentComponent emits order:confirmed → if order.payment_status === PAID OR terminal status → currentLoyaltyOrderId stays but CTA hidden via computed gate (mirrors PosOrderShowComponent.canShowLoyaltyRedeem). For non-PAID non-terminal orders → CTA visible.
reset_semantics.rationale: Per owner direction: 'loyalty applies during this order; on completion → reset'. Computed gate naturally hides CTA the moment order transitions terminal.

reset_semantics.trigger: Cart manually reset via resetCart() (PosComponent.vue:2890) → also clear currentLoyaltyOrderId.
reset_semantics.rationale: Cashier starts a fresh order; previous order id no longer relevant.

reset_semantics.trigger: resetPaymentForm() fires on `payment-form:reset` (PosComponent.vue:2582) → also clear currentLoyaltyOrderId.
reset_semantics.rationale: Form reset implies order success cycle completed; previous order id stale.

placement_options.option: A. Replace floorplan router-link with loyalty button
pros: Clean — exactly the 'where floorplan would be' space owner described.
cons: Loses V2 dine-in upgrade path (cashier can't reach floorplan if dineInEnabled toggled true in future).
Requires breaking `posFloorplan.spec.js` test (loyalty button replaces link).
FloorplanComponent.vue is still functional and reachable via direct URL — UI inconsistency.

placement_options.option: B. Sibling button: floorplan link gated by `v-if="dineInEnabled"`, new loyalty button gated by `v-if="!dineInEnabled && canShowLoyaltyCta"`
pros: Zero regression on V2 dine-in path.
Same screen real estate (mutually exclusive render).
Owner intent preserved: when dine-in is OFF (V1), the slot becomes Loyalty Redeem.
Reversible — flip dine_in_enabled in admin settings and the button swaps back.

anti_drift_checks.ssot_pricing: Discount amount comes from server response `data.discount_eur` (PosLoyaltyRedeemModal.vue:311). Frontend never computes pricing. PASS.
anti_drift_checks.permission_403: Backend 403 surfaces via translateErrorCode → permission_denied i18n key (PosLoyaltyRedeemModal.vue:325). PASS.
anti_drift_checks.double_emit_risk: If `applied` event fires twice (network retry), modal `lastResponse` is overwritten but cumulative discount risk is server-side (already_redeemed error_code rejects double redemption). PASS — backend is defensive.
anti_drift_checks.cart_reset_race: If cashier clicks Loyalty CTA → modal opens → cart resetCart called concurrently → modal still holds stale orderId. Mitigation: emit close when carts.length transitions 0. Recommended addition in build phase.

test_strategy: Vitest unit: PosComponent renders loyalty CTA when (a) dineInEnabled=false AND (b) currentLoyaltyOrderId !== null AND (c) order non-terminal.
Vitest unit: CTA hidden when dineInEnabled=true (V2 floorplan instead).
Vitest unit: CTA hidden when order is PAID.
Vitest unit: order:confirmed handler stores order info.
Vitest unit: applied event from modal triggers state refresh (totals + balance).
PHPUnit: no new tests needed (backend unchanged). Verify PosLoyaltyRedeemTest 6/6 still PASS.
Playwright: capture POS main page with cart empty (CTA hidden), with cart filled but no order id (CTA hidden), simulate post-payment non-PAID state (CTA visible).

known_limitation.issue: CASH-via-wizard flow creates order with payment_status=PAID immediately. Backend PosRedemptionService rejects PAID orders. Therefore the main-page CTA is ALSO unreachable for CASH orders unless cashier opens the CTA BEFORE confirming payment.
known_limitation.scope_correct_interpretation: Owner's 'CASH-via-wizard creates PAID immediately, current order-show CTA unreachable for cash. New main-page CTA fixes this trade-off' likely means: the main-page CTA reduces friction for OTHER payment methods (CARD/TPE/PARK) where the order is created but not yet PAID. The cashier no longer needs to navigate to PosOrderShow to apply loyalty for non-CASH unpaid orders.
known_limitation.remaining_gap: True CASH loyalty redeem requires backend change: support pre-checkout staging (apply loyalty to a transient cart state, materialize in order save payload). This is OUT of mission scope ('no backend changes needed').
known_limitation.recommendation: Document this limitation in STATUS.md. Defer to V1.0.2 backlog as 'PosLoyaltyPreCheckoutStaging'.

verdict: GO with Option B placement. Wire-up is straightforward, zero frozen-zone touch, zero backend touch. Existing event `order:confirmed` is the natural data hook. Reset semantics covered by 3 hooks: order:confirmed (terminal gating via computed), resetCart, resetPaymentForm.
